prose: The US stood alone at the UN General Assembly in dismissing AI safety concerns, leaving other nations to weigh going ahead without it. The White House line, repeated in New York and in meetings with Xi Jinping in Washington this week: US companies lead in AI, they plan to keep it that way, and Washington rejects international attempts to rein the technology in - Trump called to leave AI 'exactly where it is'.

That contrasts with Xi, who said responsible AI development is necessary, and with other Chinese officials who this week backed a global governance framework. Without US support, any such agreement will be difficult to execute.
highlights: The US stood alone at the UN in dismissing AI safety concerns.
Trump: leave AI 'exactly where it is'; reject international reins.
Xi called responsible AI development necessary.
Chinese officials backed a global governance framework this week.
Without the US, a global agreement will be hard to execute.
